title: Renewal, Expiration and Late Renewal Terms — Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
Renewal terms of Rental Property Service Contracts. The figures named below are the same on every tier: a renewal notice lead of 45 calendar days, a late-renewal grace of 30 calendar days and a term of 12 months.

**R1. Renewal notice.** Bridgewell issues one renewal notice per term stating the renewal tier and the renewal installment, priced with the portfolio discount projected for the renewal date.

**R2. Automatic renewal.** A contract with automatic renewal on renews automatically on its term end only when the renewal notice for the expiring term was issued at least the tier's renewal notice lead in calendar days before the term end date; counting runs backward from the term end date, and a notice issued exactly that many days before the term end date qualifies. The records read are the renewal notice date, the term end date and the automatic renewal setting on the contract.

**R3. Expiry.** When automatic renewal is off or the notice was late, the contract expires at the end of the term end date unless the landlord affirmatively renews before then. The landlord may turn automatic renewal off or on at any time before the term end date.

**R4. The renewed term.** A renewed term starts the day after the prior term end date with no new waiting period, at the tier parameters in force on that day and the portfolio discount counted on that day, which may differ from the notice when properties were added or dropped in between. A move to a lower tier takes effect only at renewal.

**R5. Late renewal.** An expired contract may be renewed within the tier's late-renewal grace in calendar days after its term end without a new waiting period; the count starts the day after the term end date and the boundary day itself qualifies.

**R6.** A late renewal starts a new full term on the late renewal date, failures that began between the term end and the late renewal are not covered, and per-unit caps, the aggregate limit and the refrigerant allowance restart with each new term. After the late-renewal grace period, the property needs a new contract with a new waiting period.

## R2 and R5 on the calendar (hypothetical term ending 30 June)

| Date | Under R2 (notice issued that day, automatic renewal on) | Under R5 (late renewal requested that day) |
|---|---|---|
| 16 May | 45 days before the term end: qualifies, renews automatically | — |
| 17 May | 44 days before: late, no automatic renewal | — |
| 30 July | — | 30th day after the term end: within grace |
| 31 July | — | 31st day: outside grace, a new contract with a new waiting period is needed |

## Combinations under R2 and R3

| Automatic renewal | Notice issued at least 45 days before term end | Outcome at term end |
|---|---|---|
| on | yes | renews automatically |
| on | no | expires at the end of the term end date unless the landlord affirmatively renews before then |
| off | yes or no | expires at the end of the term end date unless the landlord affirmatively renews before then |
